text: 根本原因是不好骗呗，玩不过，当年凤凰卫视的美女主持人沈星，38的高龄还把亿万富豪耍的团团转，18岁的小女孩有这心智吗？
en: The root cause is simply that she can't be easily fooled — they can't outplay her. Back in the day, Xing Shen, the beautiful presenter of Phoenix TV, at the advanced age of thirty-eight still led a billionaire around by the nose. Could an eighteen-year-old girl have that kind of cunning?

text: 娶40岁的祖宗回来吗？
en: Marry a forty-year-old diva?

text: 50岁和60岁男也不考虑40岁女。
en: Men in their fifties and sixties also don't consider women of forty.

text: 大概五年前，我们领导给一个82年的大龄未婚女同事介绍甲方公司68年的财务总监，82年的正愁怎么拒绝，没想到68年的先拒了，说是自己离异，儿子也上大学了，想找一个差不多年纪的，差不多境遇的，不想找年纪小太多，女方未婚肯定还想生孩子，但自己实在没精力了。
en: About five years ago, our manager introduced to a female colleague of ours born in '82 — an older unmarried woman — the finance director of the client company, born in '68. The '82 lady was just worrying about how to decline, but unexpectedly the '68 gentleman turned her down first, saying he was divorced and his son was already at university; he wanted to find someone about his own age and in a similar situation, and didn't want someone much younger, because an unmarried woman would surely still want children, but he simply had no energy left for that.

text: 听听，多么冠冕堂皇的理由。
en: Listen to that — what a high-sounding excuse.

text: 多么善解人意的老男人。
en: What a considerate old man.

text: 一年后，来发满月礼了，找了个90后，又生了个女儿。
en: A year later, he turned up with a full-month gift; he'd found a post-90s woman and had another daughter.

text: 才一年，这速度，赶上光速了。
en: Just a year — that speed nearly matches the speed of light.

text: 换一个赛道吧。
en: Switch to a different track.

text: 6-70岁退休领导干部还是喜欢能穿旗袍的40岁年轻姑娘的。
en: Retired leading cadres aged sixty to seventy still like forty-year-old young ladies who can wear qipao.

text: 那为什么这个男的到了40还在相亲呢？
en: Then why is this man still going to matchmaking sessions at forty?

text: 他不应该是早就成家立业，走上人生巅峰了吗
en: Shouldn't he have long since settled down, built a career, and reached the peak of life?

text: 四十岁女要配六十岁男，就是男方年龄除以二，再加十岁。
en: For a forty-year-old woman to be paired with a sixty-year-old man: take the man's age, halve it, and add ten years.

text: 这就是婚介所内部掌握的，目前最终成功率最高，最符合目现在社会经济现状的男女年龄配对公式。
en: This is the man–woman age-pairing formula used internally by matchmaking agencies — currently the one with the highest eventual success rate and the best fit with present social and economic realities.

text: 按照这个公式，四十岁男适配三十岁女，五十岁男适配三十五岁女，三十岁男适配二十五岁女…
en: According to this formula, a forty-year-old man matches a thirty-year-old woman, a fifty-year-old man matches a thirty-five-year-old woman, a thirty-year-old man matches a twenty-five-year-old woman…

text: 据说台湾柏杨的公式是男方年龄除以二加7岁，女方更年青。
en: It is said that Yang Bai of Taiwan proposed a formula of the man's age divided by two plus seven years, with the woman being younger.

text: 五十年代老版妇产科学写女人最佳生育年龄十八岁。
en: The 1950s edition of obstetrics and gynaecology states that a woman's optimal childbearing age is eighteen.

text: 现在多项研究，十八至二十怀孕概率最高，流产最低。
en: Nowadays multiple studies show that between eighteen and twenty the probability of conception is highest and the miscarriage rate is lowest.

text: 女生超过30，特别是35岁，生育能力降低较大，而且难以用试管等辅助生殖技术补救。
en: Once a woman passes thirty, especially at thirty-five, her fertility declines substantially, and it is hard to remedy with assisted reproductive technologies such as IVF.

text: 所以未生育的男生基本上都不愿意找30岁以上的特别是35以上的女生，愿意找35甚至40以上女人的男人，大多数都是离过婚有娃的，无所谓生育需求，很多都是老头了。
en: Therefore men who have not yet had children basically refuse to date women over thirty, especially over thirty-five; the men who are willing to be with women of thirty-five or even over forty are mostly divorced with children, indifferent to any need for childbearing, and many are old men.

text: 男生终生都有生育能力，做试管，男生是从几亿个精子选一个，只要不是完全无精，基本总能优选到一个合格的，在选择的过程中，已经排除了绝大部分不合格的精子，因此男生年龄大生育能力下降补救成功率高，在医院进行辅助生殖，男生的步骤和难度比女生简单容易很多。
en: Men retain fertility throughout their lives. In IVF, the man selects one sperm from hundreds of millions; as long as he is not completely azoospermic, he can essentially always pick out a qualified one. In the process of selection, the vast majority of unqualified sperm have already been eliminated; therefore, when a man is older and his fertility has declined, the success rate of any remedy is high. In hospital-based assisted reproduction, the man's steps and level of difficulty are far simpler and easier than the woman's.

text: 而女生年龄影响就太大了，不好补救。
en: Whereas the effect of a woman's age is far too great, and hard to remedy.

text: 在医院辅助生殖的技术和难点主要都针对女方。
en: In hospital-based assisted reproduction, the techniques and difficulties mainly concern the woman.

text: 女生大了卵子质量下降，甚至已绝经不排卵，女生一次只排一个到几个卵子，质量不好选不到就是选不到，辅助生殖大部分失败都在于女方试管的第一步都过不去，女生折腾半天，打针促排，养囊培养等等，但卵子质量差，选不出一个合格的，胚胎无法发育，这时候已经不用谈下一步的事了。
en: An older woman has declining egg quality, and may even have reached menopause and stopped ovulating. A woman releases only one to a few eggs at a time; if the quality is poor and none can be selected, then none can be selected. Most failures in assisted reproduction lie in the woman failing even the first step of IVF. The woman goes through all sorts of trouble — hormone injections to stimulate ovulation, blastocyst culture, and so on — yet with poor egg quality no qualified egg can be selected and the embryo cannot develop; at that point there is no point discussing the next steps.

text: 下面是几张女生怀孕概率和流产概率与年龄的关系图
en: Below are a few graphs showing how a woman's probability of pregnancy and of miscarriage relate to age.

text: 因为男性存在一个心理上的异性祛魅期。
en: This is because men have a psychological period of disenchantment with the opposite sex.

text: 肤白貌美纤细丰满，所有这些能够吸引到男性的第二性特征，对于已过了异性祛魅期的男性而言，引力是大幅衰减的。
en: Fair skin, beauty, slenderness and fullness — all these secondary sex characteristics that can attract men — for men who have already passed the period of disenchantment with the opposite sex, their pull is greatly diminished.

text: 上一辈的男性，或许在七八十岁还没过异性祛魅期，但是90后的男性，祛魅期已经显著提前了，不少90后在35岁之前就已对异性无感，至于00后，这个时间节点很可能会提前至30岁以前。
en: The previous generation of men perhaps had not passed the period of disenchantment with the opposite sex even in their seventies or eighties, but for post-90s men this disenchantment period has shifted significantly earlier; many post-90s have become indifferent to the opposite sex before the age of thirty-five, and as for post-00s, this point in time will very likely move earlier still, to before thirty.

text: 原因嘛也很简单，普男们被社会锤炼了一通，信息大爆炸时代的催化反应下，大多数的认知就被喂的相对上一辈人成熟多了，他们能分辨哪些是对自己重要的，哪些是可有可无的。
en: The reason is also simple: ordinary men have been tempered by society, and catalysed by the era of information explosion, most of their understanding has been fed into them to become far more mature than the previous generation's; they can distinguish what is important to themselves from what is dispensable.

text: 但也并不是说，过了异性祛魅期的男性就不需要结婚了，绝大多数男性还是想至少留一个后代的。
en: But that is not to say that men who have passed the period of disenchantment with the opposite sex no longer need to marry; the vast majority of men still want to leave at least one descendant.

text: 有的选的前提下，男性当然是想娶个肤白貌美纤细丰满的女性当老婆，但前提是这老婆得能生，要求可以不高，至少得生一个健康的娃就行。
en: Given a choice, of course men want to marry a fair-skinned, beautiful, slender and full-figured woman as a wife, but the precondition is that this wife must be able to bear children; the requirement need not be high — at least she should bear one healthy child.

text: 40岁的女性倒也不是不能生，但医学上过了35岁就属于高龄产妇了，就算生的下来，也要赌下下一代的健康风险。
en: A forty-year-old woman is not exactly unable to give birth, but medically, past thirty-five she counts as an advanced-age maternity patient; even if she can deliver, one must gamble on the health risk to the next generation.

text: 但如果普男普到了没得选，这时给他两个选项：
en: But if an ordinary man is reduced to having no choice, then give him two options:

text: A：肤白貌美纤细丰满的40岁女孩
en: A: a fair-skinned, beautiful, slender and full-figured 40-year-old girl

text: B：颜值差身材差气质差的25岁凤凰姐
en: B: a 25-year-old 'Phoenix sister' with poor looks, poor figure and poor temperament

text: 我赌他必定是不带犹豫的。
en: I'd wager he would not hesitate for a moment.

text: 女性过了35岁，一律当男性对待。
en: Women past thirty-five should all be treated as men.

text: 男性结婚不为了生孩子，结什么婚，结婚一下子抽取5-15年收入的现金流，就为了供一个人纯开心？
en: If a man doesn't marry in order to have children, what's the point of marrying at all? Marriage instantly drains five to fifteen years' worth of income in cash flow, just to support one person for pure enjoyment?

text: 40岁男性已经知天命了，后面收入越来越少，还不如留点钱自己养老。
en: A forty-year-old man has already 'known his destiny'; with income dwindling thereafter, he might as well keep some money to support his own old age.

text: 因为你这个问题里有潜在条件！
en: Because there is a hidden premise in your question!

text: 为什么40岁男普遍不考虑40岁女？
en: Why do forty-year-old men generally not consider forty-year-old women?

text: 山区农村40岁的五保户老光棍想找个大姨过日子的搭子多了去了，怎么没有？
en: In rural mountainous areas, there are plenty of forty-year-old bachelor 'five-guarantees' recipients who want to find an older woman to share their life with as a companion — how could there not be any?

text: 你问这些40岁女去吗？
en: Would you ask these forty-year-old women to go?

text: 你提问中的“40岁男”本身就自带前置条件，且你提问中的“40岁女”又天然否定了与前者匹配的前置条件，怎么可能能成呢？
en: The 'forty-year-old man' in your question inherently carries a precondition, and the 'forty-year-old woman' in your question naturally negates the precondition for matching with the former — how could it possibly work?

text: 你这个问题的原貌应该是：
en: The original form of your question should be:

text: 为什么有经济价值的男性普遍不考虑没有生育价值的女性？
en: Why do men of economic value generally not consider women who have no reproductive value?

text: 女的过完 30 就跟男的一样
en: Once a woman passes thirty, she's just like a man.

text: 经过对知乎婚恋版块的观察，知乎男性所有言论的基础都是：
en: Based on observation of Zhihu's marriage and dating section, the basis of all remarks made by Zhihu men is:

text: 男女关系中，女性角色基本属于服务业
en: In male–female relationships, the female role essentially belongs to the service sector.

text: 为了形成男女之间的服务关系，必然需要男性的收入远高于女性，比如月薪3K女找月薪3W男之类的
en: To form a service relationship between men and women, the man's income must be far higher than the woman's — for instance, a woman on 3K a month paired with a man on 30K a month, and the like.

text: 因为形成了巨大的收入差，所以女性的收入、社会背景都变得要么可有可无要么极其低下，最终形成男性对女性的评价系统仅剩年龄、颜值等跟不可描述业务强挂钩的条件
en: Because such a huge income gap is formed, the woman's income and social background become either dispensable or extremely low, ultimately producing a male evaluative system for women that retains only conditions strongly tied to indescribable activities — age, looks, and so on.

text: 这个问题也可以归结为以上逻辑。
en: This question can also be reduced to the above logic.

text: 我以为能够在社会工作中认识，且能够在基础生活上正确沟通并达成一致的男女都处于同一阶层和社会背景下，这意味着起码学历、职级、收入是接近的
en: I had thought that men and women who could meet through work in society and could communicate correctly on basic living matters and reach agreement all belonged to the same class and social background, which means that at least their education, rank and income were close.

text: 知乎这种及其割裂的男女关系观念是怎么形成的？
en: How did such an extremely fragmented view of male–female relations on Zhihu come about?

text: 真有意思。
en: Truly interesting.
